ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the fluke surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) localized pixels comprising <10% of the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark/black field across both lobes. Discrete white annular and circular clusters (mottling) are distributed across the mid-region and concentrated heavily on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40-45 degrees, exhibiting symmetrical depth at the fluke's vertical midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple sharp peaks and shallow valleys along the continuous boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave sweep with symmetrical curvature extending from the central notch toward the dorsal-facing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white circular/annular pixel clusters scattered across both lobes; specific high-density cluster on the upper-left quadrant and right mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin light-pixel linear disruptions visible on the lower-left fluke lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes, resulting in significant deviation from the primary trailing edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast water spray obscuring the insertion point where the fluke meets the peduncle.
